proposed_direct_memory_candidates.name: AMA: Adaptive Memory via Multi-Agent Collaboration
proposed_direct_memory_candidates.material_reason: Uses coordinated constructor, retriever, judge, and refresher roles to construct, retrieve, validate, and repair long-term memory across multiple granularities.

proposed_direct_memory_candidates.name: Memp: Exploring Agent Procedural Memory
proposed_direct_memory_candidates.material_reason: Maintains learnable and updatable procedural memory distilled from trajectories, with both offline and online memory-building modes and evidence of procedural-memory reuse across agent models.

proposed_direct_memory_candidates.name: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory
proposed_direct_memory_candidates.material_reason: Distills generalizable reasoning strategies from both successful and failed agent experiences and reuses them at test time, with executable WebArena and SWE-Bench paths.

proposed_direct_memory_candidates.name: Hindsight: Structured Agent Memory that Retains, Recalls, and Reflects
proposed_direct_memory_candidates.material_reason: Provides an executable retain-recall-reflect memory system with separate world, experience, observation, and opinion networks plus temporal and graph retrieval.

reference_only.reason: OCR-Memory uses visual encoding as an E1 memory representation for agent history; visual storage does not by itself make it an E3 vision-task comparator, and an official executable implementation was not independently bound in this pass.

n_h2_reference_research.name: ReasoningBank
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Distills reusable reasoning strategies from successful and failed agent trajectories and reuses them across later agent tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The demonstrated transfer and self-evolution remain within language-agent task families.

n_h2_reference_research.name: MemP
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Procedural memory can be reused and migrated between agent-model strengths.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: No evidence establishes the same learned decision mechanism across E1 agents, E2 structured ML, and E3 vision.

n_h2_reference_research.name: MetaMem
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Meta-memory distills transferable knowledge-utilization experience across memory tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Memory-task transfer is not equivalent to cross-environment-family decision transfer.
